chunks: 1087 - And ʿĪṣ ibn al-Qāsim narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
About a man who performs salat in a woman’s izār, in her garment, and uses her khimār as a turban, he عليه السلام said: “If she is trustworthy, then there is no harm.”

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.مَأْمُونَةً: trustworthy; relied upon regarding purity and suitability

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to pray in a woman’s garment or use her khimār as a turban?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man performing salat in garments belonging to a woman. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that there is no problem in doing so if the woman is trustworthy, indicating the permissibility of using such clothing under that condition.
